description: This source file defines the DefaultQueueAdapterReceiverMonitor class, which implements monitoring for a queue adapter receiver in Orleans.Streaming. It uses metrics counters to track initialization, read, message reception, and shutdown events, along with enqueue ages.

classes.name: DefaultQueueAdapterReceiverMonitor
classes.description: A monitor class for queue adapter receivers that tracks various metrics related to initialization, message processing, and shutdown events using counters and gauges in Orleans.

methods.name: GetOldestMessageReadEnqueueAge
methods.description: Returns a measurement of the oldest message read enqueue age in ticks.

methods.name: GetNewestMessageReadEnqueueAge
methods.description: Returns a measurement of the newest message read enqueue age in ticks.

methods.name: GetMessagesReceivedCount
methods.description: Returns a measurement of the total messages received.

methods.name: TrackInitialization
methods.description: Tracks the success or failure of initialization, its duration, and exceptions.

methods.name: TrackRead
methods.description: Tracks the success or failure of read operations, their duration, and exceptions.

methods.name: TrackMessagesReceived
methods.description: Tracks the number of messages received along with enqueue times to measure ages.

methods.name: TrackShutdown
methods.description: Tracks shutdown success or failure, duration, and exceptions.
